FogPlane__System__Config.FogPlane__System__Config__Description: Default configuration for the Fog Plane System. All distance values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.

FogPlane__Falloff__Config.FogPlane__Falloff__Config__Description: Configurable fog fall-off distance from the plane surface to full white. Slider uses discrete step values.

FogPlane__Visual__Config.FogPlane__Visual__Config__Description: Visual appearance of the draggable fog planes in the viewport. Planes are MeshBasicMaterial (unlit, Layer 1 overlay).

FogPlane__Interaction__Config.FogPlane__Interaction__Config__Descripti: Interaction settings for click-to-place and drag behaviour.

FogPlane__Camera__Config.FogPlane__Camera__Config__Description: Camera constraint padding so the camera does not clip exactly onto the fog plane surface.
